title: Learning the Intrinsic Dimensionality of Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou Trajectories: A Nonlinear Approach using a Deep Autoencoder Model
abstract: arXiv:2601.19567v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We address the intrinsic dimensionality (ID) of high-dimensional trajectories, comprising $n_s = 4\,000\,000$ data points, of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou (FPUT) $\beta$ model with $N = 32$ oscillators. To this end, a deep autoencoder (DAE) is used to infer the ID in the weakly nonlinear regime where energy recurrences are observed ($\beta \lesssim 1$). We find that the trajectories lie on a nonlinear Riemannian manifold of dimension $m^{\ast} = 2$ embedded in a $64$-dimensional phase space. By contrast, principal component analysis (PCA) together with the Participation Ratio (PR) method provides only a reasonable upper bound on the ID for each value of $\beta$. Our DAE further reveals that the ID increases to $m^{\ast} = 3$ at $\beta = 1.1$, coinciding with a symmetry-breaking (SB) phenomenon characteristic of the $\beta$ model, in which additional energy modes with even wave numbers $k = 2, 4$ become excited. translated_title: 学习Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou轨迹的本征维数：一种基于深度自编码器模型的非线性方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有N = 32个振子的Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou（FPUT）β模型高维轨迹（包含n_s = 4,000,000个数据点）的本征维数（ID）。为此，我们使用深度自编码器（DAE）在观察到能量回归现象的弱非线性区间（β ≲ 1）中推断本征维数。我们发现，这些轨迹位于嵌入在64维相空间中、维数为m* = 2的非线性黎曼流形上。相比之下，主成分分析（PCA）结合参与率（PR）方法对于每个β值只能提供本征维数的合理上界。我们的DAE进一步揭示，当β = 1.1时，本征维数增加到m* = 3，这与β模型特有的对称性破缺（SB）现象相吻合，即具有偶数波数k = 2, 4的额外能量模被激发。值得注意的是，该对称性破缺（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 利用深度自编码器首次发现FPUT β模型的高维轨迹位于嵌入64维相空间中的二维非线性流形上，且本征维数在对称性破缺发生时会增加至三维，而传统PCA方法只能给出本征维数的上界。
en_tdlr: A deep autoencoder reveals that FPUT β-model trajectories lie on a 2-dimensional nonlinear Riemannian manifold embedded in a 64-dimensional phase space, with the intrinsic dimensionality increasing to three upon symmetry breaking, whereas PCA only provides an upper bound.
